text_block_list.name: Writer C
text_block_list.text:
"—In writing this column for the special 
issue of the school newspaper produced by 
the PR committee, the author approached a 
certain horse girl..."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I finally found her...! This is a chance I 
cannot afford to miss... I must somehow 
secure this long-desired interview...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
U-Um... Stay Gold-san...! If it would be 
alright, could we talk—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
—! Oho, oho, ohooo? What's the deal, yo, 
bringin' along such a total 
cutie-patootie!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Ah............! E-Everyone is... assembled 
here together...!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Chrono-san? How unusual of you to come to 
a place like this. Could it be an 
incident? Or perhaps an accident?!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Ah, n-no...! I am terribly sorry... It is 
neither of those...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my... There is no need to apologize. 
For you to come at such a time, you must 
have quite important business, do you not?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Well... that is true, but... I have ended 
up intruding upon everyone's private 
gathering...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —Tedious. Speak at once.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Then stop scaring her any further. ...Hey, 
if you've got business with Stego, spit it 
out quick. She's headin' out on another 
journey tomorrow, after all.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...! Then... today truly is my only 
chance... In that case, I... c-cannot back 
down—!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
—Which means whaaat!? You tryin' to borrow 
our golden rice porridge! A hot pot soup 
calls for udon, doesn't it?!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Golshi-san! You are far too loud! However, 
it is true that our meeting was scheduled 
first. Would you kindly refrain from 
cutting in line?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I deeply apologize for asking so much of 
you... However... I truly wished to hear 
the words of a traveler of history... so 
fitting for this special issue...!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Now what should we do about this. Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Well then, make sure these guys don't get 
bored while we're doing the interview.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...!? M-Me... keeping everyone 
entertained...?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Yep. —Can you do it?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Anego, you must not make unreasonable 
demands. Chrono-san, please forgive our 
rudeness. Pray, do not push yourself...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
No............! In that case, there is 
something I would like to show you all. 
Please wait just a moment...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
—These are rare archival materials on 
Stego-san that I have gathered from 
second-hand bookstores and the like! 
Please, take a look...!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my... Local newspapers, overseas 
racing magazines... Even newspaper 
clippings from when she ran in kids' races 
before enrolling...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! These are all things I have never 
laid eyes on before...! Stego-san, you 
look truly joyful here!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes...! That one is a report from a city 
tournament. Her finish time and name are 
published right there...!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that one, huh. Impressive that you 
managed to get your hands on this.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I collected them hoping to write a column 
on you someday... I wanted to look over as 
many materials as possible that were 
available to acquire...

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text:
(Chatter chatter... Murmur murmur...!) 
(Whoa, awesome... Wahaha... ♪)

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Heh...! Ahaha! Are you guys really that 
into it?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: You're quite something, kid.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
No... It is nothing remarkable... If it 
allows me to hear directly from the person 
herself, this much is nothing at all...

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Is that so. Then let's get right to it. 
Before those guys get bored—

text_block_list.name: Writer C
text_block_list.text:
"—The brilliant journey she recounted was 
filled with romance that could never be 
gleaned from simple data alone!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
See ya round~~~!! Next time, let's play 
fusing the oil bubbles floatin' on top of 
ramen together~~~!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Th-Thank you very much!! Well then, excuse 
me...!

—One day, I ran into Chrono Genesis coming 
out of the Expedition Support Committee 
room, seen off by an intense bunch...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I managed to interview someone 
whom I had wanted to cover for a very long 
time...
choice_data_list: 珍しいね。何かあったのか？
珍しいね。何かあったの？

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I am filled with deep emotion... though I 
was immensely nervous the entire time...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: No, not at all...! I was simply desperate.
choice_data_list: 上手くいってよかったね

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
All for the sake of learning race 
history... I merely clung on desperately, 
you see...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Yes...! I am truly glad it worked out...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I was able to learn yet another wonderful 
piece of racing history...
